The '''Skaross system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]].

The system was the site of a [[Battle of the Skaross system|battle]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
